prediction.caseName: DOJ v. Agri Stats — Algorithmic Price Coordination in Meat Processing
prediction.statusAtPrediction: Trial date May 4, 2026 — less than 1 month away
sources: United States v. Agri Stats, Inc. (D. Minn.)
Akin Gump, Mar 16, 2026 — CMA algorithmic pricing analysis
openQuestions: Will court apply per se rule or rule of reason to data-sharing platform?
Is the 'hub-and-spoke' theory viable for data analytics platforms?
What precedent does this set for algorithmic pricing tools generally?

outcome.summary: DOJ required Agri Stats to end the exchange of competitively sensitive information among meat processors. Consent decree targets the platform operator, not the subscribing processors.
